title: Runtime Player Control Channel intent.set payload (C4 §5)
description: v0 payload for the intent.set kind. slotId rides the existing semantic-slot vocabulary; value is the slot's normalized value; ttlMs is optional (omitted = the 器's default window applies, C4 §4).

slotId.description: Semantic-slot id (existing vocabulary). An unknown id is rejected with unknownSlot.

value.description: Normalized slot value. Centered slots (head/gaze/body) accept -1..1; weight slots (blink/mouth-open/mouth-smile) and vowel slots accept 0..1. Out of range is rejected with slotValueOutOfRange (never clamped).

ttlMs.description: Optional time-to-live in milliseconds. Omitted = the 器's default window. The intent expires at receivedAtMs + (ttlMs ?? defaultWindowMs).
